newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen. Lott says no budget deal yet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen. Lott says no budget deal yet.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Thursday Republicans were still hammering out a balanced budget agreement with the White House but details remained to be spelled out before it could be announced.

Speaking to reporters after a meeting with House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Lott said, "We are still working on some details on a prospective budget agreement. ... We hope maybe we can reach agreement before the day is out but we are not there now."
One of the problems is the need to "verify exactly what we are agreeing to," particularly on tax cuts, the Misssissippi Republican said.
